notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0 "Full Release"
notes.notes:
Ahoy! In this update we added couple of cool new things and ironed out bugs.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32847889/f06425f5c525ee3241367a4e879fb7a105523331.png

General

    Ironed out some bugs.

Salty Race

    Added new crew item: Duelling Glove.
    Added a new event: Raiding Time.

QuadTrouble

    Added two new cards: Sixth Sea Lord Francis de Amazonas and Chaos King Quang.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32847889/cc8a10a93052d52f9a7febf0f3a19af35b3d318c.png  https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32847889/e9c13473cbb99687789db2c97474234e68b88f7e.png

So this is officially the full version of the game, but if we see something in need of fixing, we will patch that.

See you on the high seas! https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32847889/94d5642e6a95553d43b00169e6e84b6adc027acb.png

notes.title: Demo Version Available
notes.notes:
Ahoy! You can download the demo by clicking the button on the right side of the page. 

Included In The Demo

    Three game modes: Treasure Hunt, Avast Kraken and Quadtrouble
    Eight captains.
    Good ol' fun.


 Included In The Full Version

    All of the above
    Fourth game mode: Salty Race.
    Many Customisation settings for each game mode.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.9 "Captain Macaw"
notes.notes:
Ahoy! In the update 0.9 we added lot's of new stuff for the race mode. New settings were also added. Please welcome our new captain! He's a cool bird.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32847889/ab8cedac4cfe039cb66f52ea698560b8cb462bec.png

General

    A lot of small tweaks, bug/clitch fixes.
    Added new a new captain.
    Added "plz use controller" txt to start with first launch.

Salty Race

    Added new crew members: Pet Parakeet, Pet Monkey, Pet Cockatoo and 
 Accursed One.
    Added new goods: Cursed Idol, Gouda Cheese and Blue Cheese.

Treasure Hunt

    Added the treasure Cursed Idol, which will appear sometimes instead of	
 the golden monkey idol.
    Added new settings: can now adjust the amount of coins, idols, grog bottles, and crabs.

Avast Kraken

    You can now Krakenify your ammo in single game mode. 
(Upgrade to Kraken Bubble ammo by picking up the power up bubble)

QuadTrouble

    Added cards: Monkey Elder and Harbour Recruiter
    Added new setting: change the background colour.


That's it for this time fellow grog smugglers. The game is getting more and more ready. 

See you on the high seas! https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32847889/82bb6238f4c6b97e426eccc1f4d6f2eb60d5638b.png

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.7.2 "Early Access Release"
notes.notes:
Ahoy! Can't believe it myself! The Early Access release is finally here. For this 'final' patch we prettied up the game in many places and added a new tune for the Salty Race mode.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32847889/f69bf8c2da973c94e5c48266c4c6335f1534a257.png

General

    Squashed some bugs & made other small adjustments.
    Prettied up the game with particle effects and such in multiple game modes.

Salty Race

    Added unique music track for this mode.
    Added a minimap.
    Added a proper win congratulations for the Salty King.


That's it for this time fellow sea-lubbers. Next patch we will see more content and the development of mode number five is under way. 

See you on the high seas! https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32847889/82bb6238f4c6b97e426eccc1f4d6f2eb60d5638b.png

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.7.1 "Brave Treasure Hunters"
notes.notes:
Ahoy! It's patch time again! https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32847889/25e02d4079623b9b7e534a3c568fc2cc663656cc.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32847889/c5fb9b483538739f83fc234dc4e4f318542f497f.png

In this patch we added the inspect function for Quadtrouble and made the game mode "Five" more unpredictable and added two new cards.

Avast Kraken is cleaner playing experience now. Couldn't clean away that pesky Kraken, though.

Updated the game with pretty new graphics in many places. 

And of course, destroyed some bugs. Yarrr!

General

    Destroyed some bugs.
    Added new, shiny, game-over letters.
    Added new, golden, icon for Salty Race mode.

Treasure Hunt

    Added pretty little beach decorations.

Avast Kraken

    The game immediately ends now when there is only one ship left.
    Removed the counter: should look cleaner now.

Quadtrouble

    Added cards: Frontline Trooper and Treasure Hunter.
    Added inspect function: X (or action key 4 on keyboard) to see the ability of the card on table- or hand-cards.
    Changed the play mode "Five" a bit: the numbers are now randomized. This should make it less one sided. Also, added the description of the mode to the introduction
screen.
    Added an icon for passive, all the time active skills.
    Added spankin' new animated icon for pirate cards.
    -Smoothed out the card hand actions and added some other small stuffs.

Salty Race
    Updated some graphics.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.7 "Deep Sea Monsters"
notes.notes:
In this patch we prettied up the Salty Race and Quadtrouble and added some new cards for the latter.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32847889/3d2a552e248834b1d8c8bbc9498c2a24f08621f5.png
0.7
GENERAL
-Nailed down some bugs.

SALTY RACE
-Added a brand new horizon and some new shiny icons as well.
-Changed so that crew members can't be sold to the goods shop & vice versa.
-Added the shipwave effects.
-Meddled with the shop UI and item descriptions texts.
-Removed zoom function: a minimap will be added in an upcoming patch.

QUADTROUBLE
-Changed to play screen to match deck building screen
-and added the inspect function. (press (A) to inspect a card on table)
-Added three new cards: the Deep Sea Monsters -booster!
